summary: Mistral's Free plan includes $10 per month in API credits and access to Mistral Studio, with no credit card required. The pricing page lists Studio plus $10/mo credits on the Free card. Studio docs still describe Free mode as rate-limited API access with no card — they do not mention the $10 monthly credit.
claim_steps: Create a free account at console.mistral.ai (no credit card required).
Use the Free plan — Studio access and $10/mo API credits apply.
Generate an API key and call api.mistral.ai within published limits.
